title: Payroll Clerk
company: Baltic Recruitment Services Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Baltic Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Payroll Clerk for a client located in Darlington. Our client is looking to appoint an experienced Payroll Clerk to join their team on an interim basis while they undertake recruitment for a permanent appointment.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced payroll professional with a strong background in education payroll to join a busy and rewarding working environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting and managing the end-to-end payroll process, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time, whilst maintaining compliance with relevant payroll legislation and procedures.

This is an office based role with flexibility to work from home. Preferably 4-days in the office and 1 day working from home. Although initially an interim position, there is potential for the role to become permanent for the right candidate.

Payroll Clerk Main Duties and Responsibilities:
- Manage and process the full end-to-end payroll function for employees across the Trust.
- Process monthly payroll accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Calculate and process new starters, leavers, salary changes, contractual amendments and other employee adjustments.
- Administer statutory payments, including SSP, SMP, SPP and other relevant statutory entitlements.
- Process overtime, additional hours, deductions, allowances and absence-related payments.
- Ensure payroll information is accurate and up to date, maintaining employee records and payroll documentation.
- Reconcile payroll data and investigate and resolve any discrepancies.
- Respond to payroll-related queries from employees and managers, providing a professional and confidential service.
- Liaise with HR and other departments to ensure payroll information is received and processed correctly.
- Ensure compliance with HMRC requirements, pension regulations and relevant payroll legislation.
- Maintain strict confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and financial information.

Payroll Clerk Applicants:

Essential Requirements
- Proven experience managing end-to-end payroll within an education environment.
- Strong understanding of payroll processes, procedures and statutory requirements.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Ability to work to strict deadlines within a busy payroll environment.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

Desirable Requirements
- Previous experience using the Edupay payroll system is highly desirable.
- Experience processing payroll for a Multi-Academy Trust.

Working Monday - Thursday, 8:00am - 4:00pm and Friday, 8:00am - 3:30pm. Hourly rate is: 17.17 - 18.44 per hour (depending on experience). Although initially an interim position, there is potential for the role to become permanent for the right candidate.

title: Payroll Officer
description:
Payroll Officer - Immediate Start

Are you an experienced Payroll Officer who is immediately available and ready to step into your next temporary assignment?

We're supporting an established organisation looking for a Payroll Officer to join their team on a temporary basis, providing cover during a period of sickness absence.

If you're available to start straight away, this is an opportunity to put your payroll knowledge to good use, joining a busy team where your experience will be valued from day one.

You'll be helping to ensure payroll processes run smoothly, employees are paid accurately, and important deadlines are met.

What will you be doing?
- Processing payroll information accurately and efficiently
- Using IRIS payroll software to process and maintain payroll records
- Investigating and resolving payroll queries and discrepancies
- Ensuring payroll activities comply with HMRC guidelines and relevant legislation
- Maintaining accurate employee records and supporting day-to-day payroll administration

What are we looking for?

You'll have previous payroll experience, a good understanding of HMRC guidelines and payroll legislation, and the confidence to get up to speed quickly.

Experience using IRIS would be advantageous, although not essential.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Payroll Officer who can start immediately, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV or contact Natalie at Paul Card Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Assistant Management Accountant

Location: Ashington or Durham

Contract: Full time Permanent.

Hours: Full Time 37 per week, Monday to Friday.

Salary: Up to £32,909 per annum (dependent on experience)

Closing Date: 5pm 2nd December 2026

Do you feel that you would have the skills to ensure the timely and quality preparation of management information within a finance role?

If so, then our Assistant Management Accountant post is for you.

The Benefits:

28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) (pro-rata for part time and fixed term roles).

Health cash plan membership so you can save money by claiming cash back over £1,000 each year - towards essential healthcare costs such as dental, optical, physio and loads more. We ll also cover the costs of including any dependent children in the scheme up to the age of 21 or 24 if in full-time education that you may have.

Access to savings on gym memberships plus cash back and discounts on purchases from major retailers including supermarkets, travel, cinema and more.

Generous pension scheme with life insurance of 3 x salary

About the Assistant Management Accountant Role:

Joining our Regional and National award-winning finance team, the Assistant Management Accountant will support the Strategic Finance Team. Responsibilities include (but are not limited to) the following:

Timely and quality preparation of management information for the Group. This includes rent and service charge calculations, management accounts, budget variance analysis, cashflow forecasts, business planning and financial regulatory returns.
Preparation and analysis of large, complex datasets requiring excellent MS Excel skills and attention to detail.
Effective and efficient management of all the Group s accounting records in line with statutory obligations and current accounting requirements.
Provision of effective and efficient management information to the Group.
Ensuring excellent support services are delivered across all Group departments and external customers, including companies under the Group s management.

For further details, please see attached link to the role profile.

About you:

Successful candidates will need:

Essential

GCSEs Grades 9 - 5 or A - C in Maths and English

Minimum 12 months proven experience working in a fast-paced finance department
Sound experience of financial management systems and a working knowledge of basic financial principles and procedures
Excellent skills relating to written and verbal communication, time management, problem solving and attention to detail
IT skills including MS Excel (minimum Intermediate Level)
A customer focused and objective orientated approach.

Desirable

Have achieved or be working towards a recognised accounting qualification
Recent experience of working in finance within the social housing sector
Recent experience of rent and / or service charge setting.

About us:

We re all about helping people in need of housing. We believe a good home makes lots of other things possible, so we provide great homes and services that do just that.

We ve built Bernicia to be a business that people want to be a part of. We re one of the North East s largest and most successful housing providers; building, renting, selling and managing homes as well as providing services to over 60,000 customers.

Looking to grow your career at a company that puts its people first?

Our people are what make us great. Their feedback has recognised us as a Great Place to Work certified employer.

We operate within a set of simple, but effective values, which blend perfectly to create our unique Bernicia Way culture. This ensures we are customer focused, through working together, respecting each other, being accountable for our actions and demonstrating integrity and leadership.

Please note that some roles may involve driving for business. Where this is required, you must hold a current and valid driving licence and have suitable insurance cover.

Interviews will be taking place during week commencing 7th December 2026 and will include a 30 minute Excel and written test.

For more information regarding this role, please contact:

Lisa Clarke on (phone number removed)

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than advertised, should we receive a large volume of applications.

The Group is fully committed to the promotion of equal opportunities, and we particularly welcome applicants from groups who are currently underrepresented at Bernicia.

description:
Finance/ Accounts Administrator

6 month Contract with potential for extension or permanent employment

Newcastle - Hybrid

37. 5 hrs

Rotating Shift working - Monday-Saturday

We are looking for Finance Administrators to join an established team supporting the personal lending business of a major UK high street bank.

The role involves processing customer loan documentation, applying payments to loan accounts, supporting financial reconciliations and responding to technical finance queries from internal teams.

Key responsibilities:
- Process loan documentation and maintain accurate customer records.
- Apply payments to customer accounts.
- Support accounts in arrears and customers experiencing financial difficulties.

What we're looking for:

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
APC Accountancy is an established accounting practice based close to Middlesbrough town centre, providing a comprehensive range of accountancy and business advisory services to clients across a variety of industries.

We are looking to recruit an Accounts Assistant to join our team, supporting the delivery of accounting, tax and general accountancy services to our client portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

The role will involve a varied range of accountancy work, including:
- Preparation of accounts for sole traders, partnerships and limited companies.
- Preparation of management accounts, including posting entries directly to online accounting systems such as QuickBooks, Xero and Sage.
- Preparation of tax computations and tax returns.
- Preparation of VAT returns.
- Liaising directly with clients, responding to queries and providing day-to-day support.
- Assisting with ad hoc assignments and other accountancy work as required.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

We are looking for someone with previous experience in an accounts or bookkeeping role, preferably within an accountancy practice, who has a good understanding of accounting processes and is looking to develop their experience further.

You may be ACA/ACCA/AAT qualified/part qualified or studying, or have developed a career entirely through experience.

The successful candidate will have:
- Experience of accounts preparation and/or bookkeeping.
- Good working knowledge of accounting software, ideally Sage 50, Sage Business Cloud, Xero and IRIS.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Good numerical skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to organise and manage workloads effectively, meeting deadlines and prioritising work.
- Good communication skills and confidence dealing directly with clients.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a small team, with a practical and solution-focused approach.

What We Offer
- Salary commensurate with experience with opportunities for commission and other bonus incentives
- Investment in employee growth and personal development and training - support is on offer for those pursuing further qualifications
- Flexible hours
- Pension Scheme
- 27 days holiday per annum plus Bank Holidays
- Parking

How to Apply

If you have relevant accounts experience and are interested in joining our team, please send your CV for consideration.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Are you an experienced Accounts Assistant looking to join a stable, established company where you can put your experience to good use and become a valued member of the finance team?

Offering a 35-hour working week, this is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on transactional finance and wants a secure role where practical experience and reliability are valued over formal qualifications.

You'll be joining a busy finance team where you'll have plenty of variety in your day and the opportunity to become a trusted and valued member of the team.

What will you be doing?
- Processing high volumes of purchase invoices and raising sales invoices
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations and reconciling invoices against proformas
- Managing day-to-day finance queries and resolving discrepancies
- Supporting and assisting the Finance Manager with month-end close

What are we looking for?

You'll ideally have around 3-5 years' experience in an Accounts Assistant or similar finance role, with practical experience across invoicing and reconciliations.

You'll be organised, approachable and able to work under pressure, with the confidence to communicate effectively with colleagues across the business as well as external suppliers and customers.

Formal accounting qualifications aren't essential. What matters is the experience you've built, your attention to detail and being someone the team can rely on.

Could this be your next move?

If you're looking for a stable Accounts Assistant role with an established company, a 28,000 salary and a 35-hour working week, this is an opportunity worth exploring.

Apply today or get in touch for a confidential conversation. And if your CV isn't quite up to date, don't let that stop you. We can help with that too.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk

Join a busy finance team supporting the efficient processing of supplier accounts and maintaining accurate financial records. This role is ideal for someone with strong attention to detail and previous purchase ledger experience.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices accurately and efficiently
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and delivery notes
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving invoice queries
- Preparing supplier payment runs
- Maintaining accurate financial records and data entry
- Liaising with suppliers and internal departments to resolve discrepancies
- Supporting month-end finance activities when required

Requirements:
- Previous experience in a Purchase Ledger or Accounts Payable role
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and finance systems
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Ability to manage workload and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
